PACKMASTER-HANDY_HAVERSACK.title: Handy Haversack
PACKMASTER-HANDY_HAVERSACK.description: At the start of each combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
PACKMASTER-BAG_OF_HOLDING.title: Bag of Holding
PACKMASTER-BAG_OF_HOLDING.fragment1:
.[]
Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of each turn, lasting one turn for every [blue]5[/blue] cards in your deck.
PACKMASTER-BAG_OF_HOLDING.flavor: "Incredible! It appears that this bag connects to an extradimensional space. What if I jump inside?" - Ranwid
PACKMASTER-BANISHING_DECREE.title: Banishing Decree
PACKMASTER-BANISHING_DECREE.description: Upon [gold]pickup[/gold], choose one of your Packs. Cards from it will no longer appear in card rewards. Then, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]5[/blue] new Packs to replace it with, and obtain [blue]3[/blue] card rewards from that Pack.

PACKMASTER-BANISHING_DECREE.flavor: Absorb what is useful, reject what is useless and add what is essentially your own.
PACKMASTER-COLLECTOR_BADGE.title: Collector Badge
PACKMASTER-COLLECTOR_BADGE.description: Each turn, after you play a card from [blue]3[/blue] different Packs, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} next turn.
PACKMASTER-COLLECTOR_BADGE.fragment0: Each turn, after you play a card from [blue]3[/blue] different Packs, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} next turn.
PACKMASTER-COLLECTOR_BADGE.fragment2: NL This has triggered this turn.
PACKMASTER-GEM_OF_UNITY.title: Gem of Unity
PACKMASTER-GEM_OF_UNITY.description: Once per combat, after you have played a card from each different Pack available this run, gain [blue]20[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and heal [blue]5[/blue] HP.
PACKMASTER-GEM_OF_UNITY.fragment0: Once per combat, after you have played a card from each different Pack available this run, gain [blue]20[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and heal [blue]5[/blue] HP.
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_BOX.title: P.M. Booster Box
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_BOX.description: Upon [gold]pickup[/gold], choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] Packmaster Boosters, three times. Earn an additional card from these boosters at the end of each combat.
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_BOX.fragment0: Upon [gold]pickup[/gold], choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] Packmaster Boosters, three times. Earn an additional card from these boosters at the end of each combat.
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_BOX.flavor: Better price for buying in bulk.
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_PACK.title: P.M. Booster Pack
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_PACK.description: Upon [gold]pickup[/gold], add any one card from a random Packmaster Booster to your deck.
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_PACK.fragment0: Upon [gold]pickup[/gold], add any one card from a random Packmaster Booster to your deck.
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_PACK.fragment1: Choose a card to add to your deck.
PACKMASTER-PM_BOOSTER_PACK.flavor: A package of cards in a foil wrapper. How did it end up in the Spire?
PACKMASTER-PM_COLLECTION.title: P.M. Collection
PACKMASTER-PM_COLLECTION.description: Upon [gold]pickup[/gold], you may add each card from a random Packmaster Booster to your deck.
PACKMASTER-PM_COLLECTION.fragment0: Upon [gold]pickup[/gold], you may add each card from a random Packmaster Booster to your deck.
PACKMASTER-PM_COLLECTION.fragment1: You may add this to your deck.
PACKMASTER-PM_COLLECTION.flavor: Said to have been assembled by a consortium of wizards.
PACKMASTER-SNOWGLOBE.title: Snowglobe
PACKMASTER-SNOWGLOBE.description: Whenever you apply #y[gold]Frostbite[/gold] by attacking an enemy, apply
PACKMASTER-SNOWGLOBE.fragment0: Whenever you apply #y[gold]Frostbite[/gold] by attacking an enemy, apply
PACKMASTER-SNOWGLOBE.flavor: A depiction of the Spire during snowy weather. It growls when you shake it.
PACKMASTER-MINI_HAKKERO.title: Mini Hakkero
PACKMASTER-MINI_HAKKERO.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] #y[gold]Charge[/gold] Up.
PACKMASTER-MINI_HAKKERO.flavor: A small elemental furnace, generates enough heat and energy to destroy a mountain.
PACKMASTER-DIMENSION_CORE.title: Dimension Core
PACKMASTER-DIMENSION_CORE.description: At the start of combat, for every [blue]10[/blue] cards in your deck, shuffle [blue]3[/blue] [gold]different color[/gold] cards into your draw pile. Draw an extra card each turn.
PACKMASTER-DIMENSION_CORE.flavor: A crystal sphere containing infinite possibilities. It's cracked.
PACKMASTER-TARRED_FEATHER.title: Tarred Feather
PACKMASTER-TARRED_FEATHER.description:
Raise your max hand size by [blue]2[/blue].
At the start of each combat, add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Weights[/gold] into your hand.
PACKMASTER-TARRED_FEATHER.flavor: You wouldn't want to meet its previous wearer.
